title: Police: 4 teens charged in Lynn McDonald’s melee
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Crime They are facing multiple charges, including assault and battery with a dangerous weapon.

title: Youth hockey player suspended over slashing incident caught on video
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Local News Most of the players on the ice for Saturday’s game were reportedly just 11 years old.

Bruce Bennett/Getty Images, File By Abby Patkin September 24, 2026 | 11:24 AM 1 minute to read A youth hockey player in Massachusetts has been suspended indefinitely after slashing at an opponent with his stick during a game in Foxborough Saturday — a startling penalty caught on video.
In video obtained by WHDH, the Bay State Breakers player appeared to club a South Shore Kings player on the head, knocking them both to the ice.
